news.headline: Rajasthan BJP MLA Jaswant Yadav dies at 73 in Jaipur after prolonged battle with cancer
news.story_lead: Rajasthan BJP MLA Jaswant Yadav dies at 73 in Jaipur after prolonged battle with cancer BJP MLA Jaswant Yadav's death reduces the strength of the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly to 199, with a by-election in Behror expected within six months. BJP MLA from Behror and former Rajasthan cabinet minister Jaswant Yadav died in Jaipur on Sunday morning after a prolonged battle with cancer. He was 73.
news.full_article_text: Rajasthan BJP MLA Jaswant Yadav dies at 73 in Jaipur after prolonged battle with cancer BJP MLA Jaswant Yadav's death reduces the strength of the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly to 199, with a by-election in Behror expected within six months. BJP MLA from Behror and former Rajasthan cabinet minister Jaswant Yadav died in Jaipur on Sunday morning after a prolonged battle with cancer. He was 73. Yadav breathed his last at 8.15 am, his son Mohit Yadav said in a social media post. "It is with profound sorrow that I inform you that my revered father, Dr Jaswant Yadav ji, the current MLA from Behror, former Cabinet Minister in the Rajasthan government, and former MP from Alwar, is no longer with us," Mohit said. Also Read: BJP Alwar candidate makes ‘communal’ remark, Congress asks EC to take action Describing his father as a great soul, he said his affection, simplicity and commitment to society would remain in people's memories. Yadav was a four-time MLA and had also represented Alwar in the Lok Sabha . He served as a minister in the Vasundhara Raje-led Rajasthan government from 2016 to 2018. Also Read: Candidate choice, neglect of local issues led to BJP’s defeat in Alwar He began his political career in 1998 after winning the assembly election from Mundawar. In 1999, he was elected to the Lok Sabha from Alwar . Following his death, the strength of the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly has fallen to 199. A by-election to the Behror assembly constituency is expected to be held within six months. Also Read: Police case filed against Rajasthan MLA for alleged attempt to murder According to the family, his mortal remains will be kept at his residence in Jaswant Nagar, Alwar, for public homage after 4 pm on Sunday. His last rites will be performed at his native village Silpata in Khairthal-Tijara district at 3 pm on Monday, November 9.

news.headline: Wanted in over 30 heinous criminal cases, carried ₹5 lakh reward: Punjab gangster Gurwinder alias Afridi brought back to India
news.story_lead: Wanted in over 30 heinous criminal cases, carried ₹5 lakh reward: Punjab gangster Gurwinder alias Afridi brought back to India He is accused of directing targeted killings, extortion-related firing incidents and organised criminal networks in Punjab while operating from abroad. Gangster Gurwinder alias Afridi, wanted in more than 30 heinous criminal cases, was brought to India from Ethiopia by the Punjab Police on Sunday. Police sources told HT that this was the first time the Punjab Police had secured the return of a fugitive from an African country.
news.full_article_text: Wanted in over 30 heinous criminal cases, carried ₹5 lakh reward: Punjab gangster Gurwinder alias Afridi brought back to India He is accused of directing targeted killings, extortion-related firing incidents and organised criminal networks in Punjab while operating from abroad. Gangster Gurwinder alias Afridi, wanted in more than 30 heinous criminal cases, was brought to India from Ethiopia by the Punjab Police on Sunday. Police sources told HT that this was the first time the Punjab Police had secured the return of a fugitive from an African country. Afridi, a resident of Tut village in Tarn Taran district, carried a ₹ 5 lakh reward announced by the Punjab government. Officials said he was taken into custody by the state police at Delhi airport during the intervening night of November 7 and 8 and was being brought to Punjab to face legal proceedings. Who is gangster Gurwinder alias Afridi? An alleged key kingpin of the Doni Bal-Prabh Dassuwal gang, he is accused of directing targeted killings, extortion-related firing incidents and organised criminal networks in Punjab while operating from abroad, news agency PTI reported. He is reportedly wanted in more than 30 serious criminal cases, including five murder cases, attempted murder, extortion and offences under the Arms Act. His name surfaced during the investigation into an attack on a church in Thakkarpura village of Tarn Taran on August 31, 2022. Four masked men allegedly held the church's security guard at gunpoint, damaged statues of Lord Jesus and Mother Mary, and set the pastor's car on fire before escaping. In June 2024, Amritsar Rural Police arrested Jaswinder Singh, alias Munshi, describing him as a key accused in the case. During his initial questioning, Munshi allegedly identified Afridi and two others as his associates in the attack, HT had reported earlier. Police then began searching for the remaining suspects. Police have linked Afridi to five high-profile murders in Punjab. These include the killings of Sarpanch Rajwinder, alias Raj Talwandi, in October 2024; a 12-year-old in March 2025; Vicky Chugh in March 2025; Jaswant Singh in May 2025; and Congress block president Gurmel Singh in September 2025. How he was caught Punjab DGP Gaurav Yadav said Afridi left India from Mumbai airport for the UAE on March 31, 2025. He allegedly travelled using a fake passport obtained with the details of a resident of Gorakhpur. The passport was issued in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, on February 12, 2025. "The accused was constantly evading law enforcement agencies across several continents," Yadav said. He added that Afridi initially stayed in the UAE before attempting to reach Mexico through Istanbul. However, he was deported to the UAE. Afridi later entered Kenya in April 2026, travelled to Angola in June 2026 and moved to Ethiopia in November 2026, where he was eventually arrested. Yadav said the Punjab Police had secured an Interpol Red Notice against Afridi and regularly shared information about his false identity and movements with central agencies. “This marks the successful culmination of ‘Operation SHAHID’, a 10-month-long intelligence-led international manhunt involving sustained surveillance, strategic intelligence gathering and tracking across multiple countries in Asia, South America and Africa, executed in close coordination with national and international agencies," he said. Operation SHAHID was carried out under the supervision of Ashish Chaudhary, IGP (Overseas Fugitive Tracking and Extradition Cell or OFTEC) of the Counter Intelligence wing, who oversaw international coordination and follow-up efforts. The operation was led by Bikramjit Singh Brar, SP (Anti-Gangster Task Force/OFTEC OPs). (Inputs from Ravinder Vasudeva and PTI) - ABOUT THE AUTHOR HT News Desk Follow the latest breaking news, major developments and agenda-setting stories from India and around the world with the newsdesk at Hindustan Times. Operating round the clock, the desk brings together experienced editors, reporters and correspondents to deliver fast, accurate and contextual reporting across subjects that influence public policy, governance, business, society and international affairs. Gangster Gurwinder alias Afridi, wanted in more than 30 heinous criminal cases, was brought to India from Ethiopia by the Punjab Police on Sunday. Police sources told HT that this was the first time the Punjab Police had secured the return of a fugitive from an African country. Afridi, a resident of Tut village in Tarn Taran district, carried a ₹ 5 lakh reward announced by the Punjab government. Officials said he was taken into custody by the state police at Delhi airport during the intervening night of November 7 and 8 and was being brought to Punjab to face legal proceedings. Who is gangster Gurwinder alias Afridi? An alleged key kingpin of the Doni Bal-Prabh Dassuwal gang, he is accused of directing targeted killings, extortion-related firing incidents and organised criminal networks in Punjab while operating from abroad, news agency PTI reported. He is reportedly wanted in more than 30 serious criminal cases, including five murder cases, attempted murder, extortion and offences under the Arms Act. His name surfaced during the investigation into an attack on a church in Thakkarpura village of Tarn Taran on August 31, 2022. Four masked men allegedly held the church's security guard at gunpoint, damaged statues of Lord Jesus and Mother Mary, and set the pastor's car on fire before escaping. In June 2024, Amritsar Rural Police arrested Jaswinder Singh, alias Munshi, describing him as a key accused in the case. During his initial questioning, Munshi allegedly identified Afridi and two others as his associates in the attack, HT had reported earlier. Police then began searching for the remaining suspects. Police have linked Afridi to five high-profile murders in Punjab. These include the killings of Sarpanch Rajwinder, alias Raj Talwandi, in October 2024; a 12-year-old in March 2025; Vicky Chugh in March 2025; Jaswant Singh in May 2025; and Congress block president Gurmel Singh in September 2025. How he was caught Punjab DGP Gaurav Yadav said Afridi left India from Mumbai airport for the UAE on March 31, 2025. He allegedly travelled using a fake passport obtained with the details of a resident of Gorakhpur. The passport was issued in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, on February 12, 2025. "The accused was constantly evading law enforcement agencies across several continents," Yadav said. He added that Afridi initially stayed in the UAE before attempting to reach Mexico through Istanbul. However, he was deported to the UAE. Afridi later entered Kenya in April 2026, travelled to Angola in June 2026 and moved to Ethiopia in November 2026, where he was eventually arrested. Yadav said the Punjab Police had secured an Interpol Red Notice against Afridi and regularly shared information about his false identity and movements with central agencies. “This marks the successful culmination of ‘Operation SHAHID’, a 10-month-long intelligence-led international manhunt involving sustained surveillance, strategic intelligence gathering and tracking across multiple countries in Asia, South America and Africa, executed in close coordination with national and international agencies," he said. Operation SHAHID was carried out under the supervision of Ashish Chaudhary, IGP (Overseas Fugitive Tracking and Extradition Cell or OFTEC) of the Counter Intelligence wing, who oversaw international coordination and follow-up efforts. The operation was led by Bikramjit Singh Brar, SP (Anti-Gangster Task Force/OFTEC OPs). news.headline: Scientific, tech measures to be introduced to strengthen transparency in ghee sale: TDB to Kerala HC
news.story_lead: Scientific, tech measures to be introduced to strengthen transparency in ghee sale: TDB to Kerala HC Kochi, The TDB has told the Kerala High Court that it will introduce scientific and technological measures to strengthen transparency, accountability and financial discipline in the sale and distribution of 'Adiya Sishtam Ghee', a sacred offering of the Sabarimala temple. A bench of Justices Raja Vijayaraghavan V and K V Jayakumar said that such a system was essential to ensure that the entire quantity of ghee is properly accounted for. The court expressed satisfaction with the measures taken by the Travancore Devaswom Board , saying that they will address the major deficiencies in the existing mechanism and "are intended to strengthen transparency, accountability and financial discipline in the sale and distribution of Adiya Sishtam Ghee".
news.full_article_text: Scientific, tech measures to be introduced to strengthen transparency in ghee sale: TDB to Kerala HC Kochi, The TDB has told the Kerala High Court that it will introduce scientific and technological measures to strengthen transparency, accountability and financial discipline in the sale and distribution of 'Adiya Sishtam Ghee', a sacred offering of the Sabarimala temple. A bench of Justices Raja Vijayaraghavan V and K V Jayakumar said that such a system was essential to ensure that the entire quantity of ghee is properly accounted for. The court expressed satisfaction with the measures taken by the Travancore Devaswom Board , saying that they will address the major deficiencies in the existing mechanism and "are intended to strengthen transparency, accountability and financial discipline in the sale and distribution of Adiya Sishtam Ghee". It directed the Board to ensure that the measures are implemented strictly and in their entirety. "The Board shall ensure that the necessary technological and administrative arrangements are put in place and that the officers and employees concerned are made fully accountable for their respective duties. The entire exercise shall be completed before the commencement of the ensuing pilgrimage season 2026-27." "The Board shall also ensure that the systems introduced are subjected to regular monitoring and verification so that incidents of this nature do not recur," the court said. It also appreciated the TDB's decision to introduce scientific measurement systems, digital monitoring, computerised stock management and individual transaction tracking. "These measures, if properly implemented, would substantially reduce the scope for manipulation and ensure that the revenue generated from the sale of this sacred offering is duly accounted for and safeguarded. The Board had told the bench that it was going to introduce a scientific system for measuring the quantity of ghee available in the storage tanks. It also told the court that it would help to accurately ascertain the stock available at any given point in time, account for every transaction and reconcile the quantity of ghee received, stored and distributed with the sale proceeds. The TDB has also decided to install digital flow meters in the pipelines to ascertain the precise quantity of ghee flowing through them to the packing machines, the court had been told. The Board has also told the bench that the income and expenditure registers, stock registers and other relevant records will be maintained strictly in accordance with the prescribed procedures. It has said that frequent physical verification of the stock was contemplated and any loss, wastage or damage to the ghee shall be properly quantified and recorded in the relevant registers, so that no discrepancy remains unexplained or unaccounted for. The steel storage tanks and the vessels used for drawing ghee from the tanks will be duly calibrated to ensure accuracy in measurement, and CCTV cameras are also proposed to be installed at all the counters to facilitate continuous monitoring and prevent unauthorised activities, it had told the court. The timings of shift changes and transfers of stock between employees shall be properly recorded in the relevant registers; the entire process relating to the preparation, storage, accounting and distribution of ghee is to be computerised, and transaction tracking mechanisms as well as individual login credentials will be provided to all concerned employees, the TDB told the court. The court had initially ordered the probe for identifying the causes and circumstances that resulted in a loss of over ₹ 17 lakh to the TDB on account of the alleged misappropriation in connection with the sale of ghee at Sannidhanam during the period from November 17, 2025 to December 27, 2025. The court had initiated the petition on its own following a report by the TDB's Chief Vigilance and Security Officer pointing out that the sale proceeds of 16,628 packets of ghee sold at the shrine have not been remitted to the Devaswom account. The court had later expressed dissatisfaction with the Vigilance and Anti Corruption Bureau report in the matter, observing that the findings of the agency regarding the issue "appear to minimise the significance" of the loss caused to the Board. It had directed the appointment of a Superintendent of Police-rank officer of the VACB to reassess whether a corruption case should be registered over the alleged misappropriation of funds by employees of the TDB in the sale of 'Adiya Sishtam Ghee'. The investigation is ongoing. This article was generated from an automated news agency feed without modifications to text. - Travancore Devaswom Board

news.headline: Kerala High Court Directs SIT to Probe All Officials in Sabarimala Milma Ghee Irregularities Case
news.story_lead: The Kerala High Court has instructed the Special Investigation Team (SIT) to investigate all individuals involved in alleged irregularities surrounding the procurement and supply of Milma ghee to the Sabarimala temple. A division bench emphasized that every implicated person must be examined regardless of official position or rank, following reports of financial losses and potential compromise of prasadam quality.
news.full_article_text:
In an order issued in Kochi, a Kerala High Court division bench comprising Justice Raja Vijayaraghavan V and Justice K V Jayakumar instructed the Special Investigation Team (SIT) probing alleged irregularities in the procurement and supply of Milma ghee to Sabarimala to pursue all relevant leads. The court emphasized that the investigating agency must examine the role of every individual who may have participated in the matter, irrespective of their official rank or status.

The directive came after the bench reviewed a status report submitted by the SIT regarding its ongoing investigation. The report revealed that the investigating team has identified the principal accused in the case, with some having already approached the High Court for anticipatory bail. Additionally, investigators are probing the potential involvement of other personnel and high-ranking officials belonging to both the Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB) and Milma.

To establish responsibility, the SIT has obtained and analyzed call data records (CDR) and financial transaction details for the relevant period. Expressing satisfaction with the direction of the probe, the High Court directed the agency to conduct an impartial and exhaustive investigation and take it to its logical conclusion.

The High Court had previously mandated a vigilance inquiry after a preliminary report from the Chief Vigilance and Security Officer indicated possible coordinated misconduct involving board members and officials. The court noted that these irregularities resulted in substantial financial losses to the Travancore Devaswom Board and raised serious concerns over the potential supply of substandard ghee used in preparing 'Aravana'—a sweet payasam made of jaggery and rice given as prasadam to devotees at the Lord Ayyappa temple.
news.background_context: The Kerala High Court had previously ordered a vigilance inquiry into ghee procurement after preliminary findings by the Chief Vigilance and Security Officer indicated coordinated misconduct between Travancore Devaswom Board officials and suppliers, leading to financial losses and quality concerns.
bullet_points: Kerala High Court directed the SIT to probe every person implicated in the Sabarimala Milma ghee supply irregularities.
The bench comprised Justice Raja Vijayaraghavan V and Justice K V Jayakumar.
Judges emphasized that the investigation must proceed impartially, regardless of official position or status.
SIT has identified main accused persons, some of whom have applied for anticipatory bail.
Role of senior officials from both the Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB) and Milma is under scrutiny.
Investigating agency has secured and is examining call data records and financial transaction details.
Initial vigilance probe was triggered by a preliminary report from the Chief Vigilance and Security Officer.
Irregularities reportedly caused significant financial loss to TDB and raised quality concerns over 'Aravana' prasadam.
key_facts: Judicial Bench: Justice Raja Vijayaraghavan V and Justice K V Jayakumar
Investigating Unit: Special Investigation Team (SIT)
Institutions under investigation: Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB) and Milma
Prasadam involved: Aravana (jaggery and rice payasam)
Location of Shrine: Sabarimala Lord Ayyappa Temple, Kerala
important_dates: 2026-11-08: High Court bench issued directives to the SIT following review of the investigation report.
exam_relevance: Relevant for General Studies Paper II (Governance, Institutional Accountability, and Transparency in Statutory Bodies).
Demonstrates judicial oversight over executive agencies and public trust management.
news.upsc_analysis: The intervention of the Kerala High Court highlights the vital role of judicial oversight in maintaining institutional integrity and financial transparency within statutory entities managing public and religious trusts. By mandating an exhaustive probe into allegations of official collusion and substandard supply without regard to rank, the judiciary reinforces administrative accountability and guards public faith in government-regulated religious institutions.

Financial losses incurred by the board and quality concerns regarding temple prasadam.
impacts: Expanded investigation encompassing senior officials of the Travancore Devaswom Board and Milma.
Scrutiny of financial records and call data records of suspects.
Increased judicial oversight over the preparation of Sabarimala temple offerings.
challenges: Analyzing comprehensive call data and financial transaction records across multiple officials.
Ensuring an uninfluenced and objective investigation when senior administrative personnel are implicated.

Collection and processing of digital evidence, including call detail records and financial logs.
constitutional_or_policy_link: Judicial review powers under Article 226 of the Constitution of India.
Statutory governance rules governing Devaswom boards in managing public trust assets.
way_forward: Ensure a time-bound, evidence-based investigation to establish complete legal accountability.
Implement transparent digital procurement and strict quality assurance protocols for temple offerings.
news.mains_notes:
### Governance and Judicial Oversight in Statutory Religious Boards
- **Core Issue:** Irregularities in Milma ghee procurement for Sabarimala's 'Aravana' prasadam.
- **Judicial Bench:** Justices Raja Vijayaraghavan V and K V Jayakumar (Kerala HC).
- **Key Governance Takeaways:**
  1. **Accountability:** Directive to probe all involved individuals irrespective of official rank or status.
  2. **Institutional Fraud:** Alleged collusion between Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB) members and suppliers.
  3. **Public Trust Integrity:** Protecting the quality of sacred offerings and safeguarding public assets from financial leakage.
mains_questions: Examine the significance of judicial oversight in ensuring transparency and financial integrity within statutory bodies managing public religious trusts in India.
Discuss the administrative measures required to prevent institutional corruption and quality compromises in large-scale public procurement systems.

Aravana is a traditional sweet dish (payasam) made of jaggery, rice, and ghee offered at the Sabarimala temple.
Milma is the brand name of the Kerala Co-operative Milk Marketing Federation (KCMMF).

hindi_translation.headline: शबरीमला में मिल्मा घी की आपूर्ति में अनियमितताओं की जांच सभी अधिकारियों तक बढ़ाएं: केरल हाईकोर्ट का एसआईटी को निर्देश
hindi_translation.story_lead: केरल उच्च न्यायालय ने विशेष जांच दल (SIT) को शबरीमला मंदिर में मिल्मा घी की खरीद और आपूर्ति में हुई कथित अनियमितताओं में शामिल सभी व्यक्तियों की जांच करने का निर्देश दिया है। अदालत की पीठ ने जोर दिया कि वित्तीय नुकसान और प्रसाद की गुणवत्ता से समझौते की रिपोर्ट के बाद, पद या हैसियत की परवाह किए बिना प्रत्येक संबंधित व्यक्ति की भूमिका की जांच होनी चाहिए।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
कोच्चि में न्यायमूर्ति राजा विजयाराघवन वी और न्यायमूर्ति के वी जयकुमार की पीठ ने शबरीमला में मिल्मा घी की आपूर्ति में कथित अनियमितताओं की जांच कर रही विशेष जांच टीम (SIT) को सभी प्रासंगिक सुरागों पर काम करने का निर्देश दिया। अदालत ने स्पष्ट किया कि जांच एजेंसी को किसी भी व्यक्ति की भूमिका की जांच करनी चाहिए, चाहे उनका आधिकारिक पद या स्थिति कुछ भी हो।

यह निर्देश एसआईटी द्वारा प्रस्तुत प्रगति रिपोर्ट की समीक्षा के बाद आया। रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, जांच टीम ने मुख्य आरोपियों की पहचान कर ली है, जिनमें से कुछ ने उच्च न्यायालय में अग्रिम जमानत याचिका दायर की है। इसके अतिरिक्त, जांचकर्ता त्रावणकोर देवस्वम बोर्ड (TDB) और मिल्मा दोनों के वरिष्ठ अधिकारियों व कर्मचारियों की संभावित संलिप्तता की भी जांच कर रहे हैं।

जांच एजेंसी ने प्रासंगिक अवधि के कॉल डेटा रिकॉर्ड (CDR) और वित्तीय लेनदेन का विवरण प्राप्त कर लिया है और उनका विश्लेषण कर रही है। अदालत ने अब तक की जांच पर संतोष व्यक्त करते हुए इसे निष्पक्ष और संपूर्ण तरीके से तार्किक निष्कर्ष तक पहुंचाने का निर्देश दिया।

इससे पहले, मुख्य सतर्कता और सुरक्षा अधिकारी की प्रारंभिक जांच रिपोर्ट में टीडीबी अधिकारियों और आपूर्तिकर्ताओं के बीच समन्वित गड़बड़ी के संकेत मिलने के बाद उच्च न्यायालय ने सतर्कता जांच के आदेश दिए थे। अदालत ने उल्लेख किया कि इससे देवस्वम बोर्ड को भारी वित्तीय नुकसान हुआ और भगवान अयप्पा मंदिर में 'अरवना' (गुड़ और चावल से बना पायसम प्रसाद) की तैयारी के लिए घटिया घी की आपूर्ति की आशंका पैदा हुई।
hindi_translation.background_context: मुख्य सतर्कता अधिकारी की प्रारंभिक जांच में त्रावणकोर देवस्वम बोर्ड के अधिकारियों और आपूर्तिकर्ताओं के बीच मिलीभगत के संकेत मिलने पर केरल उच्च न्यायालय ने पूर्व में सतर्कता जांच के आदेश दिए थे।
bullet_points: केरल हाईकोर्ट ने एसआईटी को शबरीमला मिल्मा घी आपूर्ति मामले में शामिल सभी लोगों की जांच करने का निर्देश दिया।
पीठ में न्यायमूर्ति राजा विजयाराघवन वी और न्यायमूर्ति के वी जयकुमार शामिल थे।
कोर्ट ने कहा कि जांच पद या हैसियत से परे निष्पक्ष रूप से की जानी चाहिए।
एसआईटी ने मुख्य आरोपियों की पहचान की है, जिनमें से कुछ ने अग्रिम जमानत मांगी है।
त्रावणकोर देवस्वम बोर्ड और मिल्मा के वरिष्ठ अधिकारियों की भूमिका की जांच की जा रही है।
जांच एजेंसी ने कॉल डेटा रिकॉर्ड और वित्तीय लेनदेन के विवरण एकत्र किए हैं।
मुख्य सतर्कता अधिकारी की रिपोर्ट के आधार पर सतर्कता जांच शुरू की गई थी।
अनियमितताओं से बोर्ड को वित्तीय नुकसान और 'अरवना' प्रसाद की गुणवत्ता पर चिंता जताई गई है।

news.headline: Delhi Air Quality Drops to 'Very Poor' Category on Diwali, Forecasted to Turn Severe
news.story_lead: Delhi recorded an average Air Quality Index (AQI) of 376 on Diwali, placing it in the 'very poor' category amid heavy smog and low visibility. Air quality experts forecast that pollution levels will enter the 'severe' category following evening Diwali celebrations, driven by firecracker emissions, vehicular pollution, and stubble burning.
news.full_article_text:
The air quality in the national capital deteriorated sharply on Diwali day, reaching an average Air Quality Index (AQI) of 376, up from 369 recorded the previous day. Out of the 59 monitoring stations collecting data across the city, 12 registered air quality in the 'severe' range, while 22 recorded 'very poor' levels. Jahangirpuri reported the city's worst AQI reading at 463.

According to forecasts from the Air Quality Early Warning System (EWS) for Delhi, atmospheric pollution is projected to breach the 'severe' classification starting November 9 and remain elevated for several days. This expected surge is attributed to a combination of post-festival firecracker emissions, peak seasonal stubble burning in neighbouring regions, and local vehicular discharges.

Data from the Decision Support System (DSS) identified the transport sector as the single largest local contributor to Delhi's air pollution on Sunday, accounting for 19 per cent of total emissions. Stubble burning contributed an estimated 3.5 per cent on Sunday, with projections placing its share around 2.99 per cent on Monday.

Primary pollutants were dominated by PM2.5 particles. Weather conditions have further exacerbated pollutant concentration; the EWS highlighted unfavourable meteorological factors, specifically wind speeds hovering below 10 kilometres per hour and a ventilation index under 6,000 square metres per second, both of which severely restrict atmospheric pollutant dispersion.
bullet_points: Delhi's average daily AQI stood at 376 on Sunday, remaining in the 'very poor' category.
Out of 59 reporting air quality stations, 12 recorded 'severe' AQI levels and 22 recorded 'very poor' levels.
Jahangirpuri registered the highest AQI in the city at 463.
The Air Quality Early Warning System (EWS) forecasts 'severe' air quality starting November 9 for several days.
The transport sector was the largest contributor to Sunday's pollution at 19 per cent, according to the Decision Support System (DSS).
Stubble burning accounted for 3.5 per cent of pollution on Sunday and is projected at 2.99 per cent for Monday.
PM2.5 remained the primary pollutant across the capital.
Unfavourable dispersion conditions include wind speeds under 10 km/h and a ventilation index below 6,000 m²/s.
key_facts: Delhi Average AQI on Diwali: 376 ('Very Poor').
Highest recorded station AQI: Jahangirpuri at 463 ('Severe').
Transport sector pollution share: 19% on Sunday (per DSS).
Stubble burning contribution: 3.5% on Sunday, projected 2.99% on Monday.
CPCB AQI standard bands: 0-50 (Good), 51-100 (Satisfactory), 101-200 (Moderate), 201-300 (Poor), 301-400 (Very Poor), and 401-500 (Severe).
Meteorological threshold for poor dispersion: Wind speed < 10 km/h and Ventilation Index < 6,000 m²/s.

news.upsc_analysis: The data highlights that while seasonal stubble burning generates significant public focus, sector-specific urban emissions such as transportation (19%) along with adverse seasonal meteorological conditions (low wind speed and ventilation index) play a major role in pushing urban air quality into severe bands during winter transitions.

impacts: Deterioration of air quality into 'very poor' and 'severe' bands.
Elevated concentration of PM2.5 pollutants.
Reduced atmospheric visibility and dense smog layer across Delhi.
challenges: Ineffective dispersion of air pollutants due to stagnant meteorological conditions.
Compounding effect of multiple pollution sources operating simultaneously during the festival season.

hindi_translation.headline: दिवाली पर दिल्ली की वायु गुणवत्ता 'बहुत खराब' श्रेणी में पहुंची, आगे और बिगड़ने का अनुमान
hindi_translation.story_lead: दिवाली के अवसर पर दिल्ली का औसत वायु गुणवत्ता सूचकांक (AQI) 376 दर्ज किया गया, जिससे शहर में धुंध और कम दृश्यता के बीच हवा 'बहुत खराब' श्रेणी में आ गई। वायु गुणवत्ता विशेषज्ञों का अनुमान है कि आतिशबाजी, वाहनों के उत्सर्जन और पराली जलाने के कारण दिवाली के बाद वायु गुणवत्ता 'गंभीर' श्रेणी में पहुंच सकती है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
राष्ट्रीय राजधानी में दिवाली के दिन वायु गुणवत्ता में भारी गिरावट दर्ज की गई और औसत वायु गुणवत्ता सूचकांक (AQI) 376 तक पहुंच गया, जो पिछले दिन 369 था। शहर भर में डेटा एकत्र करने वाले 59 निगरानी स्टेशनों में से 12 ने 'गंभीर' श्रेणी और 22 ने 'बहुत खराब' श्रेणी में वायु गुणवत्ता दर्ज की। जहांगीरपुरी में शहर का सबसे खराब AQI 463 दर्ज किया गया।

दिल्ली के वायु गुणवत्ता प्रारंभिक चेतावनी प्रणाली (EWS) के पूर्वानुमानों के अनुसार, वायु प्रदूषण 9 नवंबर से 'गंभीर' श्रेणी को पार करने और कई दिनों तक उच्च स्तर पर रहने का अनुमान है। इस संभावित वृद्धि का कारण त्योहार के बाद पटाखों का उत्सर्जन, पराली जलाने की घटनाएं और स्थानीय वाहनों का धुआं है।

डिसीजन सपोर्ट सिस्टम (DSS) के आंकड़ों के अनुसार, रविवार को दिल्ली के वायु प्रदूषण में परिवहन क्षेत्र 19 प्रतिशत योगदान के साथ सबसे बड़ा स्थानीय स्रोत रहा। रविवार को पराली जलाने का योगदान 3.5 प्रतिशत दर्ज किया गया, जिसके सोमवार को 2.99 प्रतिशत रहने का अनुमान है।

शहर में मुख्य रूप से PM2.5 प्रदूषक मौजूद रहा। मौसम की प्रतिकूल परिस्थितियों ने स्थिति को और बिगाड़ दिया है; EWS के अनुसार, 10 किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे से कम हवा की गति और 6,000 वर्ग मीटर प्रति सेकंड से कम वेंटिलेशन इंडेक्स प्रदूषकों के बिखराव को रोक रहे हैं।
bullet_points: रविवार को दिल्ली का औसत दैनिक AQI 376 रहा, जो 'बहुत खराब' श्रेणी में है।
डेटा रिकॉर्ड करने वाले 59 स्टेशनों में से 12 में 'गंभीर' और 22 में 'बहुत खराब' AQI दर्ज किया गया।
जहांगीरपुरी में शहर का उच्चतम AQI 463 दर्ज किया गया।
वायु गुणवत्ता प्रारंभिक चेतावनी प्रणाली (EWS) ने 9 नवंबर से कई दिनों तक 'गंभीर' वायु गुणवत्ता का पूर्वानुमान जताया है।
डिसीजन सपोर्ट सिस्टम (DSS) के अनुसार परिवहन क्षेत्र 19% योगदान के साथ रविवार को प्रदूषण का सबसे बड़ा स्रोत रहा।
रविवार को पराली जलाने का योगदान 3.5% था, जो सोमवार को 2.99% रहने का अनुमान है।
राजधानी में मुख्य प्रदूषक PM2.5 बना रहा।
10 किमी/घंटा से कम हवा की गति और 6,000 वर्ग मीटर/सेकंड से कम वेंटिलेशन इंडेक्स प्रदूषकों के प्रसार में बाधक हैं।
key_facts: दिवाली पर दिल्ली का औसत AQI: 376 ('बहुत खराब')।
सबसे खराब AQI वाला स्टेशन: जहांगीरपुरी (463 - 'गंभीर')।
परिवहन क्षेत्र का प्रदूषण योगदान: रविवार को 19%।
पराली जलाने का योगदान: रविवार को 3.5%, सोमवार को अनुमानित 2.99%।
कम फैलाव के लिए मौसम संबंधी मानक: हवा की गति < 10 किमी/घंटा और वेंटिलेशन इंडेक्स < 6,000 वर्ग मीटर/सेकंड।

news.headline: SSB Jawan Found Dead at Khanuwa Border Outpost Along India-Nepal Border in UP
news.story_lead: A 33-year-old Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) jawan deployed along the India-Nepal border in Uttar Pradesh's Maharajganj district died of a gunshot wound during night duty. Police and SSB authorities have launched an investigation into the incident, which took place at the Khanuwa Border Outpost. Preliminary information indicates that the jawan was undergoing severe emotional distress following the recent passing of his elder brother.
news.full_article_text:
A 33-year-old Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) jawan stationed at the Khanuwa Border Outpost (BOP) along the India-Nepal border in Uttar Pradesh's Maharajganj district was found dead while on duty during the intervening night of Saturday and Sunday.

The deceased jawan was assigned to the SSB's 66th Battalion. At approximately 1:40 AM, fellow security personnel heard the sound of a gunshot and rushed to the spot, where they found the jawan critically injured. He succumbed to his injuries shortly after.

Following notification, a police team headed by Nautanwa Circle Officer Basant Singh arrived at the border outpost. Police took custody of the body and dispatched it for a post-mortem examination. The service rifle allegedly involved in the incident was also seized for forensic evaluation. Senior SSB officials, including DIG Deepak Barnwal, 43rd Battalion Commandant Ujjwal Dutta, and Deputy Commandants Apoorva Anand and Amit Kumar Singh, conducted an on-site inspection.

Preliminary details suggest that the jawan was experiencing grief and mental stress following the death of his elder brother roughly two and a half months ago. He had rejoined duty on October 3 after availing leave. Official investigations by both police and SSB authorities are underway to ascertain the exact circumstances surrounding the tragedy.
news.background_context: The jawan had resumed his duties at the Khanuwa Border Outpost on October 3 after returning from leave, which he had taken following his elder brother's death around two and a half months prior.

hindi_translation.headline: यूपी में भारत-नेपाल सीमा चौकी पर तैनात एसएसबी जवान का शव मिला
hindi_translation.story_lead: उत्तर प्रदेश के महाराजगंज जिले में भारत-नेपाल सीमा पर तैनात 33 वर्षीय सशस्त्र सीमा बल (एसएसबी) के एक जवान की रात की ड्यूटी के दौरान गोली लगने से मौत हो गई। पुलिस और एसएसबी अधिकारियों ने खनुवा सीमा चौकी पर हुई इस घटना की जांच शुरू कर दी है। प्रारंभिक जानकारी के अनुसार जवान अपने बड़े भाई के निधन के बाद से गंभीर मानसिक तनाव में था।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
उत्तर प्रदेश के महाराजगंज जिले में भारत-नेपाल सीमा पर खनुवा बॉर्डर आउटपोस्ट (बीओपी) पर तैनात 33 वर्षीय सशस्त्र सीमा बल (एसएसबी) का जवान शनिवार और रविवार की मध्य रात्रि ड्यूटी के दौरान मृत पाया गया।

मृतक जवान एसएसबी की 66वीं बटालियन में तैनात था। तड़के लगभग 1:40 बजे गोली चलने की आवाज सुनकर मौके पर पहुंचे साथी कर्मियों ने उसे गंभीर रूप से घायल पाया, जहां बाद में उसने दम तोड़ दिया।

सूचना मिलते ही नौतनवा क्षेत्राधिकारी बसंत सिंह के नेतृत्व में पुलिस टीम मौके पर पहुंची। पुलिस ने शव को कब्जे में लेकर पोस्टमार्टम के लिए भेज दिया। घटना में इस्तेमाल की गई सर्विस राइफल को भी जांच के लिए जब्त कर लिया गया है। एसएसबी डीआईजी दीपक बर्नवाल, 43वीं बटालियन के कमांडेंट उज्ज्वल दत्ता सहित वरिष्ठ अधिकारियों ने घटनास्थल का निरीक्षण किया।

प्रारंभिक जानकारी से संकेत मिलता है कि जवान लगभग ढाई महीने पहले अपने बड़े भाई की मृत्यु के बाद से तनाव में था। वह छुट्टी के बाद 3 अक्टूबर को ड्यूटी पर लौटा था। पुलिस और एसएसबी अधिकारी घटना के सटीक कारणों की जांच कर रहे हैं।
hindi_translation.background_context: जवान अपने बड़े भाई के निधन के बाद छुट्टी बिताकर 3 अक्टूबर को खनुवा सीमा चौकी पर पुनः ड्यूटी पर लौटा था।
bullet_points: महाराजगंज जिले में ड्यूटी के दौरान रात 1:40 बजे 33 वर्षीय एसएसबी जवान की गोली लगने से मौत हो गई।
यह घटना सशस्त्र सीमा बल की 66वीं बटालियन के खनुवा बॉर्डर आउटपोस्ट पर हुई।
गोली की आवाज सुनकर पहुंचे साथियों के प्रयासों के बावजूद जवान ने दम तोड़ दिया।
नौतनवा क्षेत्राधिकारी बसंत सिंह ने बताया कि पुलिस ने शव को पोस्टमार्टम के लिए भेजा है।
घटना में इस्तेमाल की गई सर्विस राइफल को फोरेंसिक जांच के लिए जब्त किया गया है।
एसएसबी डीआईजी दीपक बर्नवाल और कमांडेंट उज्ज्वल दत्ता सहित वरिष्ठ अधिकारियों ने घटनास्थल का दौरा किया।
प्रारंभिक जांच में ढाई महीने पहले बड़े भाई की मौत के कारण मानसिक तनाव की बात सामने आई है।
जवान छुट्टी के बाद 3 अक्टूबर को वापस ड्यूटी पर आया था।

hindi_translation.headline: कर्नाटक मंत्रिमंडल ने 1,000 डॉक्टरों की भर्ती को दी मंजूरी
hindi_translation.story_lead: कर्नाटक राज्य मंत्रिमंडल ने राज्य के सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य क्षेत्र में 1,000 डॉक्टरों की भर्ती के प्रस्ताव को आधिकारिक मंजूरी दे दी है। इस निर्णय की घोषणा राज्य के स्वास्थ्य मंत्री यूटी खादर ने की।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### चिकित्सा भर्ती के लिए मंत्रिमंडल की मंजूरी

सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य ढांचे को मजबूत करने के उद्देश्य से एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक निर्णय में, कर्नाटक मंत्रिमंडल ने 1,000 डॉक्टरों की भर्ती को मंजूरी दी है। इस फैसले की पुष्टि कर्नाटक के स्वास्थ्य मंत्री यूटी खादर ने की।

* **मुख्य तथ्य:**
  * **भर्ती का लक्ष्य:** 1,000 चिकित्सा कर्मी/डॉक्टर।
  * **स्वीकृति देने वाला प्राधिकरण:** कर्नाटक राज्य मंत्रिमंडल।
  * **प्रमुख अधिकारी:** यूटी खादर, स्वास्थ्य मंत्री, कर्नाटक।
  * **क्षेत्रीय अधिकार क्षेत्र:** कर्नाटक राज्य।

यह सरकारी फैसला राज्य भर की सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य सुविधाओं में डॉक्टरों के रिक्त पदों को भरने और स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं की पहुंच में सुधार करने के उद्देश्य से लिया गया है।

स्वास्थ्य मंत्री यूटी खादर ने भर्ती निर्णय की घोषणा की।
इस पहल का उद्देश्य राज्य के सार्वजनिक चिकित्सा ढांचे को सुदृढ़ करना है।

news.headline: Government Highlights Strategic Growth in Semiconductor and Artificial Intelligence Ecosystem
news.story_lead: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) released an update highlighting India's expanding role in the global semiconductor and artificial intelligence (AI) sectors. news.full_article_text:
### Semiconductor and AI Revolution in India

The Press Information Bureau (PIB) has issued a focus briefing on India's ongoing semiconductor and artificial intelligence (AI) revolution, outlining the country's strategy to become a key player in the global technology value chain.

#### Key Focus Areas
- **Semiconductor Ecosystem:** Initiatives aim to establish domestic semiconductor fabrication units, chip design capabilities, and packaging facilities to reduce import dependence.
- **Artificial Intelligence Integration:** Focus on deploying AI technologies across governance, healthcare, agriculture, and manufacturing, supported by compute infrastructure and talent development.
- **Strategic Autonomy:** Fostering technological self-reliance and securing critical supply chains against global disruptions.
news.background_context: India has been actively promoting domestic hardware manufacturing and deep-tech innovation through strategic policy frameworks aimed at transforming the country into a global hub for electronics design and manufacturing.

hindi_translation.story_lead: प्रेस सूचना ब्यूरो (PIB) ने वैश्विक सेमीकंडक्टर और आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस (AI) क्षेत्रों में भारत की बढ़ती भूमिका को रेखांकित करते हुए एक अपडेट जारी किया है। यह विज्ञप्ति लचीले तकनीकी बुनियादी ढांचे के निर्माण और घरेलू क्षमताओं को बढ़ाने पर राष्ट्रीय प्रयासों पर जोर देती है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### भारत में सेमीकंडक्टर और एआई क्रांति

प्रेस सूचना ब्यूरो (PIB) ने भारत की जारी सेमीकंडक्टर और आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस (AI) क्रांति पर एक विस्तृत रिपोर्ट जारी की है, जिसमें वैश्विक प्रौद्योगिकी मूल्य श्रृंखला में एक प्रमुख खिलाड़ी बनने की भारत की रणनीति को रेखांकित किया गया है।

#### मुख्य ध्यान क्षेत्र
- **सेमीकंडक्टर पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र:** पहलों का उद्देश्य आयात निर्भरता को कम करने के लिए घरेलू सेमीकंडक्टर फैब्रिकेशन इकाइयों, चिप डिजाइन क्षमताओं और पैकेजिंग सुविधाओं की स्थापना करना है।
- **आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस एकीकरण:** कंप्यूट इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर और प्रतिभा विकास द्वारा समर्थित शासन, स्वास्थ्य सेवा, कृषि और विनिर्माण क्षेत्र में एआई प्रौद्योगिकियों को लागू करने पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया गया है।
- **रणनीतिक स्वायत्तता:** तकनीकी आत्मनिर्भरता को बढ़ावा देना और वैश्विक व्यवधानों से महत्वपूर्ण आपूर्ति श्रृंखलाओं को सुरक्षित करना।

news.headline: Punjab Police brings back wanted gangster Gurwinder alias Afridi from Ethiopia
news.story_lead: Punjab Police brings back wanted gangster Gurwinder alias Afridi from Ethiopia Gurwinder aka Afridi, against whom the Punjab government had announced a reward of ₹ 5 lakh, landed at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International (IGI) Airport Punjab Police on Sunday brought wanted gangster Gurwinder alias Afridi back to India from Ethiopia. He landed at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International (IGI) Airport early in the morning and is being escorted to Punjab by a team of the Anti-Gangster Task Force (AGTF). A resident of Tut village in Tarn Taran district, Afridi carries a reward of ₹ 5 lakh announced by the Punjab government .
news.full_article_text: Punjab Police brings back wanted gangster Gurwinder alias Afridi from Ethiopia Gurwinder aka Afridi, against whom the Punjab government had announced a reward of ₹ 5 lakh, landed at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International (IGI) Airport Punjab Police on Sunday brought wanted gangster Gurwinder alias Afridi back to India from Ethiopia. He landed at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International (IGI) Airport early in the morning and is being escorted to Punjab by a team of the Anti-Gangster Task Force (AGTF). A resident of Tut village in Tarn Taran district, Afridi carries a reward of ₹ 5 lakh announced by the Punjab government . The team escorting him is being led by AGTF SP Bikram Brar, airport sources said. Police sources described the operation as the first instance of Punjab Police securing the return of a fugitive from an African country. The operation comes amid the state police's efforts to track down gangsters who have fled overseas. To strengthen these efforts, Punjab Police has established an Overseas Fugitive Tracking and Extradition Cell (OFTEC) to coordinate with central agencies and foreign law enforcement authorities. Special DGP (AGTF) Parmod Ban and Special DGP (Counter Intelligence) are expected to address a press conference later on Sunday. Cases against Afridi Afridi's name surfaced in the investigation into the August 31, 2022, attack on a church in Thakkarpura village of Tarn Taran . Four masked men allegedly held the church's security guard hostage at gunpoint, vandalised statues of Lord Jesus and Mother Mary and set the pastor's car on fire before fleeing. In June 2024, Amritsar Rural Police arrested Jaswinder Singh alias Munshi, describing him as a key accused in the case. During preliminary interrogation, Munshi allegedly named Afridi and two others as his accomplices in the attack, Hindustan Times had reported earlier. Police subsequently began looking for the other suspects. Afridi was also named in a 2021 FIR registered at Sadar Patti police station in Tarn Taran under Sections 380 and 457 of the IPC, relating to theft and house-breaking, and Section 25 of the Arms Act. However, the Punjab and Haryana High Court quashed the FIR and subsequent proceedings against the petitioners in February 2024 after a compromise between the parties. - ABOUT THE AUTHOR Ravinder Vasudeva Assistant Editor with the Punjab Bureau of Hindustan Times, based in Chandigarh. Having experience of covering Punjab with permanent postings at Bathinda, Patiala, Ludhiana and Jalandhar in various capacities before moving to Punjab Bureau in 2017. Headed Doaba Bureau for three years at Jalandhar.Before joining the Hindustan Times in Punjab worked as a stringer in journalist in Himachal Pradesh, building extensive experience in grassroots reporting. news.headline: Ex-Tech Mahindra executive shot 15 times by neighbour in Faridabad, had come home for Diwali
news.story_lead: Ex-Tech Mahindra executive shot 15 times by neighbour in Faridabad, had come home for Diwali Police say the suspect fired multiple rounds and was arrested the next day. Relatives say the families had argued over a dog and parking-related issues. A 43-year-old software company executive who lived in Singapore was allegedly shot dead by a neighbour at his Faridabad family residence late on Friday, with the assailant firing 15-19 rounds that left the victim dead at the spot.
news.full_article_text: Ex-Tech Mahindra executive shot 15 times by neighbour in Faridabad, had come home for Diwali Police say the suspect fired multiple rounds and was arrested the next day. Relatives say the families had argued over a dog and parking-related issues. A 43-year-old software company executive who lived in Singapore was allegedly shot dead by a neighbour at his Faridabad family residence late on Friday, with the assailant firing 15-19 rounds that left the victim dead at the spot. The victim was identified as Paramjith Dhankhar, 43, who was employed by Vietnam-based FPT Software Company Limited at its Singapore office and was visiting his family for Diwali . He was previously a senior executive at Indian tech firm Tech Mahindra . The suspect was identified as 42-year-old Mohan Sharma, a contractor and scrap-processing businessman. He was arrested from Ballabgarh on Saturday and his licensed handgun, with 59 live cartridges kept inside the bag used for storing the weapon, and two magazines—one of which was partially loaded—were recovered, police said. Deep Dive The two men lived on different floors of four-storey building in Faridabad’s Sector 21C. Relatives of the victim said that the two families had been embroiled in a dispute for the past three months over the Sharma’s German Shepherd pup defecating in the parking on the ground floor, following which Dhankhar’s family had filed a police complaint. “A week ago, Sharma had broken one of the three stilt entrance gates Dhankhar had constructed to avoid a dispute. He had filed a police complaint,” a relative, requesting anonymity, said. Also Read | Parking dispute turns deadly in Lucknow: 3 of a family shot dead, accused held Dhankhar is survived by his parents, wife and two children—a 14-year-old daughter and an 18-year-old son— who lived in the same building. The suspect’s family lived on the second floor, police said. On Friday morning, police had summoned Sharma to the Ankhir police post on Dhankhar’s complaint. In the complaint, Dhankhar’s family had alleged verbal abuse and damage to the entrance gate for objecting to the pup defecating in the parking lot, including over the opening of the underground water tank. “My cousin also reached there. I had got to know from my brother that Sharma had misbehaved with the police too inside the station. He issued there that he would teach him a lesson,” the relative said. Around 8.30pm, Sharma asked Dhankhar to come to the parking lot and move his car, after saying that the issue was resolved and he didn’t want any more conflict, another relative said. As soon as he went downstairs, he was shot dead, the family said. Also Read | ‘Op Safed Sagar’ veteran attacked over Gurugram parking dispute; FIR says ‘hit with iron rod ’ A senior police officer privy to the investigation, said that Dhankhar tried to save himself but Sharma opened fire at close range. “He emptied one magazine and then loaded another one and emptied it too. Overall, he had fired at least 19 rounds, with at least nine hitting Dhankhar. There were multiple bullet marks on Dhankhar’s Mahindra XUV 7XO, floor and walls of the stilt area,” the officer said. An FIR was filed, naming Sharma, his wife and two children under sections 103 (1) (murder), 109(1) (attempt to murder), 351(2) (criminal intimidation), 3(5) (common intention) and 61 (criminal conspiracy) of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita at Surajkund police station on Saturday. Pinta Ram, an eyewitness, who lives on the first floor, said he heard multiple loud bangs in quick succession. “Within seconds, we all heard screams and rushed downstairs to find that Sharma had shot Dhankhar dead,” he said. Ram said they rushed him to a private hospital, but doctors declared him dead on arrival. Varun Kumar Dahiya, assistant commissioner of police (crime), said Sharma was arrested from Dealer Chowk in Ballabagarh. “He will be taken on police remand. His wife and children have also been made accused for criminal conspiracy but were yet to be arrested,” Dewan said. Also Read | Man’s ear bitten off during parking brawl in Ggm, 3 booked Family members and police said that Sharma probably planned to murder Dhankhar, since he had gone downstairs with the handgun and two loaded magazines. “When we reached the spot, the handgun holster, pistol and two magazines were recovered from the stilt area by police,” Manuj Bajaj, Dhankhar’s close friend, told HT. The family said that Dhankhar had also planned to attend a nephew’s wedding in Faridabad on November 24. - ABOUT THE AUTHOR Debashish Karmakar Debashish Karmakar is a principal correspondent with the Hindustan Times, Gurugram bureau. He has a vast journalistic experience of almost 14 years of covering crime, court, power, transport, administration, weather and other beats while working across various organisations. He has been covering Gurugram, Faridabad, Nuh, Palwal and other districts of southern Haryana for more than four and a half years. He has produced several breaking and exclusive stories while reporting from the ground where he maintains a strong presence on a daily basis. He writes news articles which are hard-hitting and accurate. With his strong bureaucratic sources, he frequently writes stories to expose the failure of the system forcing authorities to take necessary course-corrective steps. Besides crime, important convictions and court orders, he also writes on human-angle stories, on power issues and challenges faced by the residents on a daily basis in Gurugram and neighbouring areas. In the past, he worked for media houses like The Times of India, where he extensively reported on important government matters and daily proceedings at the Patna High Court. He has also worked in the electronic media and had done ground coverage on the Kedarnath deluge that wrecked Uttarakhand in 2013. Read More

news.headline: 4 of family, including 2 children, killed in Odisha fire; short circuit suspected: Cops
news.story_lead: 4 of family, including 2 children, killed in Odisha fire; short circuit suspected: Cops The cause of the fire is yet to be ascertained, though a short circuit is suspected, the police said. Four members of a family, including two children aged 11 years and eight months, were burnt alive in a fire that broke out in their house in Odisha’s Jajpur district, police said on Sunday. The incident occurred around 8pm on Saturday, at Sk Nizam Uddin’s residence in Nalipur village under Badachana block of Jajpur district.
news.full_article_text: 4 of family, including 2 children, killed in Odisha fire; short circuit suspected: Cops The cause of the fire is yet to be ascertained, though a short circuit is suspected, the police said. Four members of a family, including two children aged 11 years and eight months, were burnt alive in a fire that broke out in their house in Odisha’s Jajpur district, police said on Sunday. The incident occurred around 8pm on Saturday, at Sk Nizam Uddin’s residence in Nalipur village under Badachana block of Jajpur district. The cause of the fire is yet to be ascertained, though a short circuit is suspected, the police said. According to local resident Ajay Kumar Samal, Nizamuddin arrived from Gopalpur on Saturday with his daughter and grandchildren. "The fire broke out when his elder daughter-in-law was cooking. His daughter, daughter-in-law and the two children died in the incident," Samal said. On being informed, fire services personnel from Chandikhol and Balichandrapur police rushed to the spot and launched firefighting and rescue operations. The deceased were identified as Nizamuddin's daughter Gul Afsa Parveen (26), daughter-in-law Tabassum Parveen (40), granddaughter Roshni Parveen (11) and an eight-month-old grandson, Jajpur Superintendent of Police (SP) Yashpratap Shrimal said. A youth sustained serious burn injuries in the incident. He was initially admitted to the Badachana Community Health Centre but later shifted to Cuttack after his condition deteriorated. - ABOUT THE AUTHOR Debabrata Mohanty Debabrata Mohanty is a senior assistant editor of Hindustan Times who works as state correspondent from Odisha covering the state's politics, governance, public policy, natural disasters, environment and its society for close to three decades. With his long years of reporting from the state capital of Bhubaneswar, Mohanty has been known as one of the most experienced and credible journalists covering Odisha for the national English dailies. Four members of a family, including two children aged 11 years and eight months, were burnt alive in a fire that broke out in their house in Odisha’s Jajpur district, police said on Sunday.

The incident occurred around 8pm on Saturday, at Sk Nizam Uddin’s residence in Nalipur village under Badachana block of Jajpur district. The cause of the fire is yet to be ascertained, though a short circuit is suspected, the police said.

According to local resident Ajay Kumar Samal, Nizamuddin arrived from Gopalpur on Saturday with his daughter and grandchildren. "The fire broke out when his elder daughter-in-law was cooking. His daughter, daughter-in-law and the two children died in the incident," Samal said.
On being informed, fire services personnel from Chandikhol and Balichandrapur police rushed to the spot and launched firefighting and rescue operations.

The deceased were identified as Nizamuddin's daughter Gul Afsa Parveen (26), daughter-in-law Tabassum Parveen (40), granddaughter Roshni Parveen (11) and an eight-month-old grandson, Jajpur Superintendent of Police (SP) Yashpratap Shrimal said.
A youth sustained serious burn injuries in the incident. He was initially admitted to the Badachana Community Health Centre but later shifted to Cuttack after his condition deteriorated.

news.headline: JNU student attacks fellow student over friendship with woman; victim loses sight in one eye
news.story_lead: JNU student attacks fellow student over friendship with woman; victim loses sight in one eye According to the hospital, the student sustained severe injuries to his right eye, nose, face and shoulders, besides multiple fractures. A Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) student allegedly attacked a fellow student with a meat cleaver over his friendship with a woman student, leaving him with severe injuries, including loss of vision in one eye, police said. The incident took place around 3 pm on November 5 in room 119 of the Barak Hostel on campus.
news.full_article_text: JNU student attacks fellow student over friendship with woman; victim loses sight in one eye According to the hospital, the student sustained severe injuries to his right eye, nose, face and shoulders, besides multiple fractures. A Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) student allegedly attacked a fellow student with a meat cleaver over his friendship with a woman student, leaving him with severe injuries, including loss of vision in one eye, police said. The incident took place around 3 pm on November 5 in room 119 of the Barak Hostel on campus. The victim, identified as Saurabh, a second-year language student, was attacked on Thursday by the accused, Ajay, who allegedly objected to his friendship with a woman student, they said on Saturday. Ajay allegedly assaulted Saurabh with the cleaver, inflicting serious injuries to his head, face, hand and eye. The incident left bloodstains on the premises, with eyewitnesses reporting traces of blood from the first floor to the ground floor, triggering shock among students and faculty members. Also Read | Gurugram man strangled by friend, 2 others over lost auto-rickshaw earnings, body dumped 9km away He was rushed to the AIIMS Trauma Centre, where doctors informed the police that he had lost vision in his right eye. Saurabh underwent surgery and was undergoing treatment at the trauma centre till Saturday evening, officials said. According to the police, Ajay, who is pursuing his MA at the university, also sustained injuries in the incident. Three other students were injured during the altercation, taking the number of injured students to four, they said. Also Read | 28-year-old hacked to death, friend hurt in Badlapur over business dispute; 2 held, hunt on for 11 accused The woman student, who was friends with Saurabh, approached the police with a complaint following the incident. Based on her complaint, the Vasant Kunj North police station registered an FIR on Friday under sections, including attempt to murder. No arrest had been made in the case till Saturday evening, police said. Deputy Commissioner of Police (Southwest) Amit Goyal said an FIR had been registered, and an investigation was underway. Also Read | Pune man kills friend, cuts off both legs. SIM card cover helps crack case In an order issued by the Proctor's Office, four students were rusticated under Sections 32(1) and 32(3) of the JNU Act, 1966, following the violence. The students have been barred from the university campus with immediate effect, pending the completion of a proctorial inquiry. The administration has also warned of strict disciplinary action against anyone found providing shelter to the expelled students on the campus. In a statement, the university said it has robust institutional mechanisms for students to seek redressal of grievances and follows a zero-tolerance policy towards violence. - Jawaharlal Nehru University

news.headline: Vedic Rituals at DMK Leader's Family Wedding Spark Ideological Debate in Tamil Nadu
news.story_lead: A political and ideological debate has emerged in Tamil Nadu over the conduct of traditional Vedic rituals and Sanskrit chants at the wedding of DMK General Secretary Duraimurugan's granddaughter. Dravidar Kazhagam (DK) President K. Veeramani publicly criticized the event as a departure from rationalist Dravidian ideals, prompting Duraimurugan to express regret while explaining he relented to his granddaughter's personal preference.
news.full_article_text:
### Ideological Debate Surrounds Vedic Rituals at DMK General Secretary's Granddaughter's Wedding

A controversy over party ideology and personal religious practices has erupted in Tamil Nadu following the wedding of Senthamarai, granddaughter of senior Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) leader Duraimurugan, to Deepak Ravi, son of film producer Kannan Ravi.

#### Core Objections Raised by Dravidar Kazhagam
- **Divergence from Rationalism**: Dravidar Kazhagam (DK) President K. Veeramani expressed strong disapproval regarding the engagement of priests, Vedic rituals, and Sanskrit chants during the marriage ceremony, emphasizing that such traditions contradict the founding rationalist movement's principles.
- **Contrasting Imagery**: Veeramani pointed out the inconsistency between the wedding invitation—which carried images of iconic Dravidian movement leaders—and the actual ceremony solemnized by traditional priests.
- **Call for Leadership Action**: Citing Duraimurugan's senior standing as General Secretary, Veeramani appealed to DMK Chief and Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M. K. Stalin to intervene and prevent similar deviations among party leaders in the future.

#### Clarification and Regret by DMK Leadership
- **Concession to Personal Choice**: In a statement to the media on November 6, Duraimurugan expressed regret over the dispute and requested that the matter not be politicized. He explained that his granddaughter, who studied overseas and married outside her caste, specifically requested a traditional ceremony.
- **Adherence to Tradition vs. Party History**: Duraimurugan noted that while he yielded to her persistent request, his own marriage and the wedding of his son, Kathir Anand, were conducted without religious rituals and were solemnized directly by former CM and late DMK leader M. Karunanidhi.

#### Event Details and Dignitaries Present
- **Date and Place**: The wedding took place on November 1 in Chennai.
- **Prominent Attendees**: The event was attended by Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M. K. Stalin, along with prominent film personalities including actors Dhanush and Sivakarthikeyan.
news.background_context: The Dravidian movement historically promotes social reform, rationalism, and self-respect marriages conducted without religious rites or priest officiating, contrasting with traditional Vedic ceremony practices.

The wedding included Vedic rituals and Sanskrit chants conducted by priests.
DK President K. Veeramani criticized the ceremony for defying rationalist Dravidian principles.
Veeramani highlighted the contrast between Dravidian leaders' photos on the invitation and the priest-led rituals.
Veeramani urged DMK Chief M. K. Stalin to prevent similar events among party leaders.
Duraimurugan expressed regret on November 6, stating he accepted his granddaughter's choice as she educated abroad and married inter-caste.
Duraimurugan reiterated his personal commitment, noting his own and his son Kathir Anand's weddings were ritual-free marriages solemnized by M. Karunanidhi.
Dignitaries present at the event included CM M. K. Stalin and actors Dhanush and Sivakarthikeyan.

hindi_translation.story_lead: डीएमके के महासचिव दुरैमुरुगन की पोती की शादी में पारंपरिक वैदिक अनुष्ठानों और संस्कृत मंत्रोच्चार को लेकर तमिलनाडु में एक राजनीतिक विवाद खड़ा हो गया है। द्रविड़ कड़गम (डीके) के अध्यक्ष के. वीरमणि ने इसे द्रविड़ आंदोलन के तर्कवादी सिद्धांतों के विपरीत बताते हुए आलोचना की, जिसके बाद दुरैमुरुगन ने खेद व्यक्त किया।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### डीएमके महासचिव की पोती के विवाह में वैदिक रस्मों पर वैचारिक विवाद

वरिष्ठ द्रमुक (डीएमके) नेता दुरैमुरुगन की पोती सेंथमारई और फिल्म निर्माता कन्नन रवि के बेटे दीपक रवि के विवाह समारोह के बाद पार्टी की विचारधारा और व्यक्तिगत धार्मिक रीति-रिवाजों को लेकर एक बड़ा विवाद पैदा हो गया है।

#### द्रविड़ कड़गम द्वारा उठाई गई आपत्तियां
- **तर्कवाद से भटकाव**: द्रविड़ कड़गम के अध्यक्ष के. वीरमणि ने पुजारियों द्वारा कराए गए वैदिक अनुष्ठानों और संस्कृत मंत्रोच्चार पर कड़ी आपत्ति जताई। उन्होंने कहा कि यह द्रविड़ आंदोलन के मूल तर्कवादी सिद्धांतों का उल्लंघन है।
- **निमंत्रण और रस्मों में अंतर**: वीरमणि ने ध्यान दिलाया कि शादी के कार्ड पर द्रविड़ आंदोलन के अग्रदूतों और द्रमुक नेताओं की तस्वीरें थीं, जबकि समारोह पारंपरिक पुजारियों द्वारा संपन्न कराया गया।
- **नेतृत्व से अपील**: वीरमणि ने द्रमुक अध्यक्ष और तमिलनाडु के मुख्यमंत्री एम. के. स्टालिन से मांग की कि वे भविष्य में पार्टी नेताओं के परिवारों में ऐसी घटनाओं को रोकने के कदम उठाएं।

#### डीएमके नेता की सफाई और खेद
- **व्यक्तिगत इच्छा का सम्मान**: 6 नवंबर को मीडिया से बात करते हुए दुरैमुरुगन ने इस मामले पर खेद जताया और इसे राजनीतिक मुद्दा न बनाने का अनुरोध किया। उन्होंने बताया कि उनकी पोती, जिसने विदेश में पढ़ाई की है और अंतरजातीय विवाह किया है, ने पुजारियों द्वारा शादी की रस्में कराने का विशेष आग्रह किया था।
- **पार्टी निष्ठा की पुनरावृत्ति**: दुरैमुरुगन ने स्पष्ट किया कि उनकी अपनी शादी और उनके बेटे काथिर आनंद की शादी बिना किसी धार्मिक अनुष्ठान के दिवंगत द्रमुक नेता एम. करुणानिधि द्वारा संपन्न कराई गई थी।

#### आयोजन का ब्योरा और उपस्थिति
- **तिथि और स्थान**: यह विवाह 1 नवंबर को चेन्नई में आयोजित हुआ था।
- **प्रमुख अतिथि**: समारोह में मुख्यमंत्री एम. के. स्टालिन के अलावा अभिनेता धनुष, शिवकार्तिकेयन और फिल्म उद्योग की कई प्रमुख हस्तियां शामिल हुईं।
hindi_translation.background_context: द्रविड़ आंदोलन ऐतिहासिक रूप से तर्कवाद, समाज सुधार और पुरोहित-रहित स्वाभिमान विवाह (सेल्फ-रिस्पेक्ट मैरिज) का समर्थन करता है, जो पारंपरिक वैदिक अनुष्ठानों के विपरीत है।

डीके अध्यक्ष के. वीरमणि ने द्रविड़ आंदोलन के सिद्धांतों के खिलाफ बताते हुए इसकी आलोचना की।
वीरमणि ने निमंत्रण पत्र पर द्रविड़ नेताओं की फोटो और रस्मों में पुजारियों की मौजूदगी के विरोधाभास को रेखांकित किया।
वीरमणि ने सीएम एम. के. स्टालिन से ऐसी घटनाओं को रोकने का आग्रह किया।
दुरैमुरुगन ने 6 नवंबर को खेद प्रकट करते हुए कहा कि उन्होंने पोती की जिद के कारण उसकी इच्छा स्वीकार की।
दुरैमुरुगन ने बताया कि उनका और उनके बेटे काथिर आनंद का विवाह एम. करुणानिधि द्वारा बिना रस्मों के संपन्न कराया गया था।
समारोह में सीएम एम. के. स्टालिन और अभिनेता धनुष तथा शिवकार्तिकेयन उपस्थित थे।

news.story_lead: Explosions were reported on Qeshm Island in Iran following recent missile strikes. The strategically located island in the Persian Gulf sits near vital international shipping lanes.
news.full_article_text:
### Defence & Security: Explosions Reported on Iran's Qeshm Island

Explosions were reportedly heard on Iran's Qeshm Island following targeted missile strikes on the region.

- **Incident Details:** Loud detonations were reported across Qeshm Island after missile impacts.
- **Geographical Significance:** Qeshm Island is located in the Strait of Hormuz at the mouth of the Persian Gulf, making it a key strategic location for Iran.
- **Regional Implications:** Security developments in this maritime zone draw international attention due to the dense oil tanker traffic passing through the Strait of Hormuz.

Qeshm Island is situated strategically near the Strait of Hormuz in the Persian Gulf.

hindi_translation.story_lead: ईरान के केश्म द्वीप पर हाल ही में हुए मिसाइल हमलों के बाद विस्फोटों की आवाज सुनी गई। फारस की खाड़ी में स्थित यह द्वीप सामरिक दृष्टि से अत्यंत महत्वपूर्ण है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### रक्षा एवं सुरक्षा: ईरान के केश्म द्वीप पर विस्फोट की खबर

मिसाइल हमलों के बाद ईरान के केश्म द्वीप पर तेज विस्फोट सुने गए।

- **घटना का विवरण:** फारस की खाड़ी में स्थित केश्म द्वीप पर मिसाइल हमलों के बाद विस्फोट दर्ज किए गए।
- **भौगोलिक महत्व:** केश्म द्वीप ईरान का सबसे बड़ा द्वीप है जो होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य के निकट स्थित है।
- **क्षेत्रीय प्रभाव:** इस क्षेत्र में सुरक्षा संबंधी घटनाएं वैश्विक ऊर्जा आपूर्ति और समुद्री व्यापार मार्गों को प्रभावित कर सकती हैं।
bullet_points: मिसाइल हमलों के बाद ईरान के केश्म द्वीप पर विस्फोट सुने गए।
केश्म द्वीप फारस की खाड़ी में होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य के पास स्थित है।
यह घटना मध्य पूर्व में सुरक्षा परिदृश्य के संदर्भ में महत्वपूर्ण है।
इस क्षेत्र से प्रमुख तेल परिवहन मार्ग गुजरते हैं।

hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### डकार में ओलंपिक-थीम आधारित फैशन कार्यक्रम

सेनेगल के डकार में "फैशन इज अ टीम स्पोर्ट्स" विषय पर आधारित एक ओलंपिक-थीम वाले फैशन शो का आयोजन किया गया। इस शो में खेल संस्कृति, रचनात्मक परिधान और कलात्मक प्रदर्शन का संगम देखा गया।

* **कार्यक्रम स्थल**: डकार, सेनेगल।
* **मुख्य विषय**: "फैशन इज अ टीम स्पोर्ट्स" (Fashion is a team sport)।
* **प्रमुख क्षेत्र**: वैश्विक खेल अभियानों के संदर्भ में एथलेटिक पहचान और रचनात्मक उद्योगों का एकीकरण।
bullet_points: सेनेगल के डकार में ओलंपिक-विषयक फैशन कार्यक्रम का आयोजन किया गया।
यह शो 'फैशन इज अ टीम स्पोर्ट्स' थीम के तहत प्रस्तुत किया गया।
कार्यक्रम में खेल तत्वों को फैशन डिजाइन और कलात्मक प्रस्तुतियों के साथ जोड़ा गया।
यह आयोजन डकार की अंतरराष्ट्रीय सांस्कृतिक और खेल आयोजनों में बढ़ती भूमिका को दर्शाता है।

news.headline: Taniya Secures Historic Silver Medal in Beach Wrestling at Youth Olympic Games in Dakar
news.story_lead: Indian wrestler Taniya created history by winning a silver medal in beach wrestling at the Youth Olympic Games held in Dakar. This marks India's first-ever medal in the beach wrestling discipline at the Youth Olympics. Her performance highlights the growing diversity of India's international sporting achievements beyond traditional mats.
news.full_article_text:
### Historic Achievement in Dakar

Indian athlete Taniya achieved a landmark milestone by securing a silver medal in beach wrestling at the Youth Olympic Games taking place in Dakar. With this victory, she became the first Indian wrestler to earn a medal in the beach wrestling discipline at the Youth Olympics.

### Key Event Details

- **Athlete:** Taniya (India)
- **Discipline:** Beach Wrestling
- **Event:** Youth Olympic Games (Dakar)
- **Medal Won:** Silver Medal
- **Significance:** India's maiden medal in beach wrestling at the Youth Olympic Games stage.

### Impact on Indian Sports

The historic medal underscores the expanding scope of wrestling in India, extending success from traditional freestyle and Greco-Roman formats on mats to sand surfaces. Taniya's victory serves as a major milestone for youth combat sports development in India.

vocabulary.meaning_hindi: बीच कुश्ती (रेत पर खेली जाने वाली कुश्ती)

hindi_translation.headline: तानिया ने रची इतिहास, डकार यूथ ओलंपिक्स में बीच कुश्ती में भारत का पहला रजत पदक जीता
hindi_translation.story_lead: भारतीय पहलवान तानिया ने डकार में आयोजित यूथ ओलंपिक खेलों में बीच कुश्ती में रजत पदक जीतकर इतिहास रच दिया। यह यूथ ओलंपिक्स में बीच कुश्ती अनुशासन में भारत का पहला पदक है। उनकी यह उपलब्धि पारंपरिक मैट से परे भारत की अंतरराष्ट्रीय खेल सफलताओं की बढ़ती विविधता को दर्शाती है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### डकार में ऐतिहासिक उपलब्धि

भारतीय एथलीट तानिया ने डकार में आयोजित यूथ ओलंपिक खेलों में बीच कुश्ती में रजत पदक हासिल करके एक ऐतिहासिक मील का पत्थर हासिल किया। इस जीत के साथ, वह यूथ ओलंपिक्स के बीच कुश्ती स्पर्धा में पदक जीतने वाली पहली भारतीय पहलवान बन गईं।

### प्रमुख आयोजन विवरण

- **एथलीट:** तानिया (भारत)
- **खेल स्पर्धा:** बीच कुश्ती (Beach Wrestling)
- **प्रतियोगिता:** यूथ ओलंपिक खेल (डकार)
- **प्राप्त पदक:** रजत पदक
- **महत्व:** यूथ ओलंपिक खेलों के मंच पर बीच कुश्ती में भारत का पहला पदक।

### भारतीय खेलों पर प्रभाव

यह ऐतिहासिक पदक भारत में कुश्ती के दायरे के विस्तार को रेखांकित करता है, जो मैट पर पारंपरिक फ्रीस्टाइल और ग्रीको-रोमन प्रारूपों से बढ़कर रेत की सतहों तक पहुँच चुका है। तानिया की जीत भारत में युवा कॉम्बैट खेलों के विकास के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण पड़ाव है।
bullet_points: तानिया ने डकार में आयोजित यूथ ओलंपिक खेलों में बीच कुश्ती में रजत पदक जीता।
वह यूथ ओलंपिक्स में बीच कुश्ती में पदक जीतने वाली पहली भारतीय बनीं।
यह उपलब्धि गैर-पारंपरिक कुश्ती प्रारूपों में भारत की बढ़ती उपस्थिति को दर्शाती है।
यूथ ओलंपिक खेलों में दुनिया भर के युवा एथलीट विभिन्न खेल विधाओं में प्रतिस्पर्धा करते हैं।
तानिया का पदक यूथ ओलंपिक खेलों में भारत की कुल पदक तालिका में योगदान देता है।
बीच कुश्ती को अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर यूनाइटेड वर्ल्ड रेसलिंग (UWW) द्वारा संचालित किया जाता है।

news.headline: Dispute over parking, dog ended in ex-Tech Mahindra executive's murder in Faridabad; neighbour arrested
news.story_lead: Dispute over parking, dog ended in ex-Tech Mahindra executive's murder in Faridabad; neighbour arrested The victim had arrived in India from Singapore on November 5 to celebrate Diwali with his family and was also scheduled to attend his nephew's wedding. A dispute over parking space and a dog in Faridabad's Sector 21C turned fatal on Friday night when the former regional business head of Tech Mahindra’s Asia-Pacific region was shot dead by his neighbour. The accused, who fled after opening fire at the victim, was arrested later.
news.full_article_text: Dispute over parking, dog ended in ex-Tech Mahindra executive's murder in Faridabad; neighbour arrested The victim had arrived in India from Singapore on November 5 to celebrate Diwali with his family and was also scheduled to attend his nephew's wedding. A dispute over parking space and a dog in Faridabad's Sector 21C turned fatal on Friday night when the former regional business head of Tech Mahindra’s Asia-Pacific region was shot dead by his neighbour. The accused, who fled after opening fire at the victim, was arrested later. Paramjith Dhankhar, who had returned from Singapore just a day earlier to celebrate Diwali with his family, was shot dead by his neighbour Mohan Sharma after an argument over parking escalated. Sharma allegedly fired 15 rounds, nine of which hit Dhankhar. Parking, dog dispute between neighbours Tensions between the two families had been mounting over Sharma’s dog defecating in the parking area. This prompted repeated objections from Dhankhar’s family. The disagreement had led to several confrontations over the past few days, including an argument four to five days before the shooting. An argument broke out between Dhankhar and Sharma again on Friday night over car parking. Following this, Sharma allegedly called Dhankhar out of his house and shot him multiple times with his licensed pistol. Also read: Kochi doctor's phone reveals sexual abuse of several women after he alleges assault by Malayalam actors The two families lived in the same building, with Dhankhar’s family on the ground floor and Sharma’s on the second floor. Accused arrested from Ballabgarh Sharma had allegedly fled with his family following the fatal shooting. However, he was later arrested from Ballabgarh in Faridabad, police said. “The suspect is being quizzed and will be produced before a Faridabad court and taken on police-remand for detailed interrogation,” Faridabad ACP (crime) Varun Kumar Dahiya said. As reported by HT earlier , Dhankhar, was settled in Singapore and was working as the senior vice-president of a software company. He had arrived in India from Singapore on November 5 to celebrate Diwali with his family. He was also scheduled to attend his nephew’s wedding on November 24. Dhankar's son Shaurya Dhankhar filed an FIR under section 103(1) (murder) of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the Arms Act was registered at Surajkund police station on Saturday, according to police. - ABOUT THE AUTHOR Sana Fazili Sana started her career in 2018 with News18 and later moved to BoomLive. In the meantime, she thought it was a good idea to share what she learnt, hence took up part-time teaching of journalism course at Jamia Millia Islamia, which she says, she thoroughly enjoyed-not sure if the feeling was mutual. For a year, she also tried her hands at communication roles, only to realise she was more comfortable with news. So, joined HT in September 2025. Not much of a talker, always up for chai and sarcasm. And pun always intended. Her tag line is 'I will figure out, but I need to panic first' Read More
