news.headline: What we know so far after Krakow gun attack
news.story_lead: - Published 7 November 2026, 17:48 GMT At least six people were killed and several others injured when a gunman suspected to have ties to the far-right opened fire in central Krakow, the second largest city in Poland. Three bodies were found at his home when it was searched by police. Here's everything we know so far.
news.full_article_text: - Published 7 November 2026, 17:48 GMT At least six people were killed and several others injured when a gunman suspected to have ties to the far-right opened fire in central Krakow, the second largest city in Poland. Three bodies were found at his home when it was searched by police. Here's everything we know so far. How did the attack unfold? The attack began shortly before 15:00 local time (14:00 GMT) in Krakow's Main Market Square, the bustling central point of the city. Police said a man drove into the square before beginning to fire "at random people from his car". Footage from the scene shows scenes of panic as people fled, with the sound of gunfire clearly heard. - Follow live updates from Krakow A passing tram was shot at during the apparently random attack, shattering windows but no passengers were injured. People run for shelter as gunshots heard in Krakow Armed officers raced to the scene and engaged in a gunfight with the attacker, who was shot within three minutes of the attack beginning, preventing a further massacre, officials said. The gunman was shot but is alive and has been arrested. Distressing footage authenticated by BBC Verify shows the moment a police officer confronts the suspect on the ground before firing his weapon several times. The officer then falls to the ground, apparently having been injured himself. Moment police officer appears to shoot Krakow suspect Shop windows in the square have signs of damage, seemingly from bullets, with glass shards scattered along the floor. City officials have urged people who live in the city and tourists to stay away from the area while an investigation continues. The suspect's car, found at the intersection of Dietla and Stradomska streets, is being checked for possible explosive devices, police say. Residents of nearby buildings are being evacuated while the operation is under way. How many people have died and been injured? Six people - four women and two men - are confirmed to have been killed, including a British national. Three victims are Polish and two have not been identified. Sixteen people, including five foreigners and the attacker, were taken to hospital. Among those being treated are two police officers who were shot while detaining the attacker. Poland's Prime Minister Donald Tusk later said three bodies - two women and one man - were found at the gunman's house when it was searched after the attack. One of the police officers was described as being in a "very critical condition" by a Polish government minister after being shot three times while arresting the attacker. The officer is undergoing surgery, he added. Polish authorities have not confirmed the names and ages of the other victims. What do we know about the suspect and motive? Police have identified the attacker as a 25-year-old Polish man but have not confirmed his name. The suspect was wearing "military-style attire" and had a military-grade weapon, according to a police spokesperson. However, authorities have confirmed the attacker was not a soldier. "Many pieces of weapons and ammunition were found in his vehicle", the spokesperson added. Polish media has reported the suspect had a firearms permit and may have obtained the weapons from his family home. A minister has said early investigations indicate he was inspired by "far-right ideologies". The minister also described him as an "ultra-nationalist" without giving further details. His home is being searched with support from counter-terrorism police. How did witnesses describe the attack? The shooting happened in one of the largest medieval squares in Europe, a busy location which is also a popular tourist destination. Jonathan Balshaw from Ipswich was there with his Polish girlfriend Dominika. The couple were outside St Mary's Basilica, in the corner of the square, when the shooting started. Jonathan said: "We ran down the side of the church and through the side door and hid with several other people until the gunfire died down. "A lot of shots were fired, more than 20 with it sounding like multiple different firearms - there were two distinctly different noises." Caitlin Shasby from Newcastle arrived in Krakow yesterday with her friend Jon for a long weekend. She said they heard shots from their hotel room but were not sure what was happening until their hotel rang them and told them to "stay in our rooms until further notice". Moment shooting heard in Krakow square What has the reaction been in Poland and internationally? Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk is on his way to Krakow and is expected to give an address later on Saturday. Earlier, he said he was being kept informed by the interior minister and that police were investigating "the background and all the circumstances". Krakow Mayor Åukasz GibaÅa has signed an order declaring a period of mourning in the city which will last until Wednesday, November 11. President Karol Nawrocki said he was "deeply concerned" and was awaiting "a full explanation of the circumstances surrounding these tragic events". US ambassador to Poland Tom Rose described it as a "savage and murderous attack". The EU's top diplomat, Kaja Kallas, said the shooting was "a tragedy that will be felt far beyond Poland". news.headline: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh Visits Bagdogra Air Force Station Ahead of Diwali
news.story_lead: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh paid an official visit to the Bagdogra Air Force Station in West Bengal ahead of the festival of Diwali. During the visit, he appreciated the dedication, service, and operational readiness of the Indian Air Force personnel.
news.full_article_text:
### Defence Minister Visits Bagdogra Air Force Station

Defence Minister Rajnath Singh visited the Bagdogra Air Force Station in West Bengal ahead of the Diwali festival celebrations. The visit served as an occasion to interact directly with troops and assess airbase operational readiness.

### Key Highlights
* **Appreciation for IAF Personnel:** The Defence Minister praised the Indian Air Force (IAF) personnel for their steadfast dedication, service to the nation, and continuous vigilance.
* **Festive Engagement:** The leadership interaction took place in the run-up to Diwali, following the tradition of senior defense officials spending time with armed forces personnel stationed across key military outposts during major festivals.
* **Strategic Airbase Location:** Bagdogra Air Force Station, located near Siliguri in West Bengal, plays a significant role in Eastern India's aerial defence and logistical connectivity.

hindi_translation.story_lead: रक्षा मंत्री राजनाथ सिंह ने दिवाली के त्योहार से पहले पश्चिम बंगाल के बागडोगरा वायु सेना स्टेशन का आधिकारिक दौरा किया। अपने दौरे के दौरान, उन्होंने भारतीय वायु सेना के जवानों के समर्पण, सेवा और परिचालन तत्परता की सराहना की।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### रक्षा मंत्री का बागडोगरा वायु सेना स्टेशन का दौरा

रक्षा मंत्री राजनाथ सिंह ने दिवाली त्योहार से पहले पश्चिम बंगाल स्थिति बागडोगरा वायु सेना स्टेशन का दौरा किया। यह दौरा सैनिकों से सीधे बातचीत करने और एयरबेस की परिचालन तैयारियों का जायजा लेने का एक अवसर था।

* **वायु सेना कर्मियों की सराहना:** रक्षा मंत्री ने राष्ट्र के प्रति निष्ठा और निरंतर सतर्कता के लिए भारतीय वायु सेना (IAF) के कर्मियों की प्रशंसा की।
* **उत्सव के दौरान दौरा:** प्रमुख त्योहारों के दौरान महत्वपूर्ण सैन्य ठिकानों पर तैनात सशस्त्र बलों के जवानों के साथ समय बिताने की परंपरा के तहत यह दौरा आयोजित किया गया।
* **रणनीतिक एयरबेस:** पश्चिम बंगाल के सिलीगुड़ी के पास स्थित बागडोगरा वायु सेना स्टेशन पूर्वी भारत की हवाई रक्षा और रसद सहायता में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है।

news.exam_corner_topic: RBI Clarification on Cheque Book Rules Rumours
static_gk: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) was established on April 1, 1935, under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
The central bank was nationalised in 1949 and is headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
news.headline: Reserve Bank of India Dismisses Viral Claims Regarding New Cheque Book Rules Implementation
news.story_lead: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has clarified that viral reports claiming the introduction of new cheque book rules starting from January are fake. The central bank dismissed these unverified claims circulating on social media to prevent confusion among bank account holders. Banking customers are advised to rely strictly on official communications issued by the RBI.
news.full_article_text:
### RBI Clarification on Cheque Book Rules

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has issued a clarification dismissing claims circulating regarding the implementation of new cheque book rules starting in January. The central bank categorized these reports as fake, reassuring banking customers and account holders that no such changes have been mandated by the regulator.

**Key Factual Details:**
* **Official Stance:** The Reserve Bank of India confirmed that rumors regarding new cheque book regulations taking effect from January are false.
* **Public Advisory:** Customers are urged to verify banking rules and policy updates directly through official RBI press releases and verified communication channels rather than unverified social media messages.
bullet_points: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has labeled claims of new cheque book rules taking effect in January as fake.
Reports circulating regarding modified cheque book guidelines were clarified to be false.
The central regulator advised bank customers not to fall for unverified rumors on social media.
Official guidelines or regulatory updates are communicated directly through RBI's official channels.
key_facts: RBI dismissed claims of new cheque book rules taking effect from January as fake.
The central bank issued a public clarification regarding viral rumors.
important_dates: 2026-11-07: Date of report on RBI dismissing fake claims about new cheque book rules.
exam_relevance: Prelims: Awareness of RBI's regulatory role, public communication mechanisms, and financial literacy initiatives.
Mains: Impact of financial misinformation on banking sector stability and consumer confidence.
news.upsc_analysis: Prompt central bank clarifications serve to prevent misinformation from damaging public trust in basic financial instruments like cheques and ensure smooth banking operations.
causes: Circulation of unverified claims and social media reports regarding fake cheque book rule changes.
impacts: Mitigation of panic and confusion among bank account holders and financial consumers.
challenges: Controlling the widespread dissemination of financial rumors across digital platforms.
government_steps: Issuance of a public statement by the Reserve Bank of India clarifying the reports as fake.
constitutional_or_policy_link: Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 (regulating monetary authority and banking supervisory functions).
way_forward: Promote financial literacy and encourage consumers to rely solely on official central bank notifications.
news.mains_notes: Financial misinformation can disrupt public trust in banking operations. Central bank communications act as a vital countermeasure to maintain stability and prevent consumer distress caused by viral social media rumors.
mains_questions: Examine the challenges posed by financial misinformation on digital platforms and the role of central bank communications in preserving public trust.
Discuss the regulatory measures undertaken by the Reserve Bank of India to ensure banking literacy and transparency.
news.takeaway: The RBI has declared reports regarding new cheque book rules from January as fake, urging customers to trust only official central bank updates.
prelims_facts: The Reserve Bank of India formally dismissed claims of new cheque book rules starting from January as fake.

hindi_translation.headline: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक ने जनवरी से नए चेक बुक नियमों के दावों को किया खारिज
hindi_translation.story_lead: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (RBI) ने स्पष्ट किया है कि जनवरी से नए चेक बुक नियम लागू होने के दावे फर्जी हैं। केंद्रीय बैंक ने बैंक खाताधारकों के बीच भ्रम से बचने के लिए सोशल मीडिया पर फैल रही इन अफवाहों को खारिज कर दिया। बैंकिंग ग्राहकों को केवल आरबीआई के आधिकारिक बयानों पर भरोसा करने की सलाह दी गई है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### चेक बुक नियमों पर आरबीआई का स्पष्टीकरण

भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (RBI) ने जनवरी से नए चेक बुक नियमों के लागू होने के दावों को खारिज करते हुए एक स्पष्टीकरण जारी किया है। केंद्रीय बैंक ने इन खबरों को फर्जी करार दिया और बैंकिंग ग्राहकों को आश्वस्त किया कि नियामक द्वारा ऐसा कोई बदलाव लागू नहीं किया गया है।

**प्रमुख तथ्यात्मक विवरण:**
* **आधिकारिक रुख:** भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक ने पुष्टि की कि जनवरी से लागू होने वाले नए चेक बुक नियमों से जुड़ी अफवाहें पूरी तरह से गलत हैं।

news.exam_corner_topic: Probe into National Health Mission Staff Appointments in Kerala

news.headline: Kerala Government Announces Probe into National Health Mission Staff Appointments
news.story_lead: The Kerala state government has decided to initiate an inquiry into the recruitment of staff within the National Health Mission (NHM). The announcement was made by the state Health Minister following concerns surrounding appointment procedures.
news.full_article_text:
### Kerala Probe into NHM Recruitment

The Kerala State Government has announced an official investigation into staff recruitment procedures conducted under the National Health Mission (NHM) in the state. According to statements from the Health Minister of Kerala, the decision aims to examine appointments made across various administrative and clinical cadres within the mission to ensure transparency and address potential recruitment irregularities.

### Administrative Oversight and Implementation

The National Health Mission (NHM) functions as a major centrally sponsored program supporting state healthcare infrastructure primarily through contractual and regular personnel deployments. The probe will scrutinize procedural adherence during past recruitment drives to verify whether merit, eligibility criteria, and established institutional guidelines were followed while filling staff positions in Kerala's NHM units.
bullet_points: Kerala state government has initiated a probe into staff appointments within the National Health Mission.
The decision was formally announced by the Kerala Health Minister.
The investigation aims to review procedural compliance and transparency in recruitment drives.
NHM provides key health workforce support across rural and urban healthcare institutions.
The inquiry focuses on addressing reported concerns regarding staff selection practices.

The probe targets staff selection procedures under the state's National Health Mission.
important_dates: 2026-11-07: Announcement of the probe into NHM appointments in Kerala
exam_relevance: Prelims: Core objectives, administrative structure, and sub-missions (NRHM & NUHM) of the National Health Mission.
Mains: Institutional governance, recruitment transparency, and public accountability in Centrally Sponsored Schemes.
news.upsc_analysis: The investigation into NHM appointments highlights key issues surrounding administrative governance, recruitment integrity, and institutional oversight in state-level delivery of health services supported by central funding.
causes: Concerns and alleged irregularities regarding procedural compliance in staff appointments under NHM Kerala.
impacts: Increased administrative oversight and potential reform in health sector recruitment procedures.
challenges: Maintaining uninterrupted public health services while conducting administrative reviews of workforce appointments.

way_forward: Implementation of standardized, transparent, and digitized recruitment protocols for contractual healthcare personnel to prevent procedural lapses.

mains_questions: Examine the role of transparent recruitment mechanisms in maintaining the institutional integrity of Centrally Sponsored Schemes like the National Health Mission.

prelims_facts: Kerala Health Minister announced a probe into NHM staff recruitment.
National Health Mission is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme administered by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### केरल में एनएचएम भर्ती की जांच

केरल राज्य सरकार ने राज्य में राष्ट्रीय स्वास्थ्य मिशन (NHM) के तहत कर्मचारियों की भर्ती प्रक्रियाओं की जांच का ऐलान किया है। स्वास्थ्य मंत्री के अनुसार, इस निर्णय का उद्देश्य मिशन के प्रशासनिक और परिचालन कैडर में की गई नियुक्तियों की समीक्षा करना है ताकि पारदर्शिता सुनिश्चित की जा सके और संभावित अनियमितताओं को दूर किया जा सके।

### प्रशासनिक देखरेख और कार्यान्वयन

राष्ट्रीय स्वास्थ्य मिशन (NHM) एक प्रमुख केंद्र प्रायोजित योजना है जो मुख्य रूप से संविदात्मक और नियमित कर्मचारियों के माध्यम से राज्य की स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं का समर्थन करती है। प्रस्तावित जांच का उद्देश्य भर्ती प्रक्रिया में नियमों के पालन की समीक्षा करना है ताकि यह जांचा जा सके कि योग्यता और निर्धारित दिशानिर्देशों का सही पालन हुआ है या नहीं।
bullet_points: केरल सरकार ने राष्ट्रीय स्वास्थ्य मिशन के तहत कर्मचारियों की भर्ती की जांच शुरू की।
निर्णय की घोषणा राज्य की स्वास्थ्य मंत्री द्वारा की गई।
जांच का उद्देश्य भर्ती प्रक्रियाओं में पारदर्शिता और नियमों का पालन सुनिश्चित करना है।
